- name: Require production Supabase credentials when migrations changed
        if: ${{ steps.migrations.outputs.changed == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          missing=0
          for name in SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD; do
            if [ -z "${!name}" ]; then
              echo "::error::$name is not configured. A real Supabase migration changed, so production schema deployment cannot be skipped."
              missing=1
            fi
          done
          if [ "$missing" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit 1
          fi
